document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
This is an excellent library! In little time you locate five pertinent 
books. To use each, you must succeed with the correct language 
roll, or employ a translator. One hour is required for each book: 
• For the Pnakotic Manuscript (Latin), go to 289.
• For Col. F. Dupont’s Le Culte d’Aten (French), go to 265.
• For Die Goules (German), go to 243.
• For The Pharaoh’s Curse, A Novel, go to 264.
• For Breasted’s History of Egypt, go to 251.
When you have finished, return to 215. 
(215, 243, 251, 264, 289)
